findings.finding: Part of the evidence that the bug does not reproduce is false. The plan says the full `main --slot standard --limit 1 --epochs 1` run used `--concurrency 4`-equivalent threading. But provider_parity.main parses `--concurrency` and never passes it to `run_slot` (main calls `run_slot(slot, items, v1_config=..., v2_config=..., epochs=args.epochs)`, so the default is concurrency=1). Also, run_arm only uses the thread pool when `len(items) > 1`, and `--limit 1` gives one item. So the `main` run was sequential.
findings.location: What is established — 'That line did not reproduce at 83ca81e709e' bullet; src/rebar/llm/evals/provider_parity.py:594, :631
scenarios: If the 872e7f6c3fd emitter only fires under concurrent tracker reads, this reproduction attempt could not have caught it through `main`, and the operator's real `--concurrency N` invocation never ran in parallel either.
findings.suggested_fix: Change the evidence bullet to say only the direct `run_arm` sweeps were threaded. Separately, either add `concurrency=args.concurrency` to the `run_slot` call in provider_parity.main (and a unit test for it) or file it as its own ticket.

findings.finding: The mount helper fails silently. It skips on a tracker override, when there is no repo root, when the main repo has no store, or on any Exception/SystemExit, and it only logs at debug level. If the mount does not happen, the harness still makes every model call, and every `show_ticket` read still returns 'ticket system not initialized'. The plan's stated harm (measured verdicts that depend on worktree state) then recurs with nothing on stderr. The plan adds no check after the mount, so the fix covers the common case but does not guarantee the outcome the problem statement needs.
findings.location: Approach ("never raises") / provider_parity.py main after the mount call
scenarios: The main checkout's tracker is unavailable or the attach fails, so the mount quietly does nothing. The parity run then records E4/G1G2 verdicts produced from tool errors as real model decisions.
REBAR_ROOT points somewhere without a store. The mount returns early, and the operator gets an apparently valid parity report.
findings.suggested_fix: Right after the mount call in each harness `main`, resolve `root = rebar.config.repo_root_or_none()`. If `root` is set, `not rebar.config.tracker_dir_override()`, and `not rebar.config.tracker_dir(root).is_dir()`, then write `"warning: no .tickets-tracker mounted at <root>; show_ticket reads will fail and results are not representative"` to stderr, or return exit code 2 before any model call. Add a test that stubs the mount as a no-op and checks the warning or refusal.
